subunits.name: ES6+ Basics
subunits.content: Modern JavaScript features like let/const, template literals, and enhanced object literals that form the foundation of React development.

subunits.name: Functions, Arrow Functions
subunits.content: Understanding traditional functions versus arrow functions, especially regarding lexical scope and 'this' binding which is crucial in React class and functional components.

subunits.name: Arrays & Objects
subunits.content: Mastering array methods like map, filter, and reduce for rendering lists and managing state, along with object manipulation techniques.

subunits.name: Destructuring, Spread/Rest
subunits.content: Efficiently extracting values from arrays and objects using destructuring, and using the spread/rest operators for immutable state updates in React.

subunits.name: Modules, Promises
subunits.content: Using ES Modules (import/export) to organize code and understanding Promises as the base for asynchronous data fetching.

subunits.name: Async/Await
subunits.content: Modern syntax for handling asynchronous operations, making code more readable and easier to manage when dealing with APIs in React components.

subunits.name: DOM & Events
subunits.content: Understanding the relationship between the Virtual DOM and the real DOM, and how React handles events through its synthetic event system.
